ai.summary: Forescout researchers built a tool to test if generally available AI models could find security flaws on a limited budget. They examined both open-source code and compiled software whose source code was unavailable, testing an approach attackers could also use. The team confirmed 99 vulnerabilities across 10 TCP/IP stacks, the software components that allow devices to communicate over networks.
